# Data-quality report (generated by src/p2_quality.py)

Bronze: 1,682,616 rows, 24,064 banks. Silver: 1,666,719 rows, 23,788 banks. Model scope (to 2025-06-30): 1,649,471 rows, 10,860 with y = 1, 2,837 failed banks; 3,547 y = 0 rows are near misses; 65,282 y = 0 rows have a non-failure exit inside the window.
